baseline_models.focus_anchor: جَنَّاتِ, بِالْغَيْبِ, and the doubled وَعَدَ/وَعْدُ ending in مَأْتِيًّا
baseline_models.mechanism: A tree-screened destination is presently outside sight, but the doubled promise converts concealment from absence into an expected arrival.

activation_trace.role: The tree-screened garden supplies a real destination whose enclosure also preserves an image of concealment.
What is hidden from eyes supplies the present epistemic distance of the destination.
The repeated promissory commitment opens expectation and binds the hidden object to fulfillment.
Coming and arrival turn the promise from remote description into an approaching event.

changed_reading.before: The ayah describes unseen gardens promised for a later time.
changed_reading.after: The ayah makes concealment and certainty cooperate: the destination is screened now, while the promise already gives it the direction of arrival.

baseline_models.mechanism: The promise can be heard as an appointed time-place whose realization is already grammatically characterized as an occurrence that will become present and accessible.

activation_trace.role: The appointment branch gives the promise a bounded temporal or spatial horizon rather than leaving it as bare speech.
Occurrence and presence in time frame the promise as an established event.
Readiness and an accessible way of coming make fulfillment a prepared eventuality.

changed_reading.before: A speaker guarantees a future reward.
changed_reading.after: The guarantee also behaves like an appointment already entered into the order of events, awaiting its becoming present.

baseline_models.mechanism: Mercy names the promisor while submitted service names the recipients, so the promise is carried by a continuing relation rather than by an isolated transaction.

activation_trace.role: Tender mercy and beneficence characterize the agency issuing the promise.
Humble service identifies the addressed community and supplies the relational response to mercy.
Promissory commitment holds the two sides of that relation across present invisibility.

changed_reading.before: The verse states a reward and its beneficiaries.
changed_reading.after: The unseen interval is sustained by a mercy-service relation: the identity of promisor and recipients is part of how the promise remains live.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediately preceding movement into the same garden converts the focus's hidden destination into a threshold that is actually crossed.

activation_trace.role: The focus supplies the enclosed garden that is presently promised in the unseen.
Visual absence marks the condition from which the contextual movement begins.
Literal entry supplies the threshold-crossing action by which the hidden promise becomes inhabited.
The repeated tree-screened garden identifies the entered object with the focus destination.

structural_cues: 19:60 places turning, trust, and repaired action before explicit entry into the garden, then closes by negating any loss.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies entry into the repeated garden; I infer that entry is one concrete mode of the focus promise's arrival. Alternatively, 19:60 may state eligibility while 19:61 independently grounds certainty.

changed_reading.before: The garden is principally an unseen object guaranteed by speech.
changed_reading.after: The promise points to a traversable boundary: what is hidden now is realized as actual entry, not merely later visibility.

context_deltas.mechanism: The following ayah fills the screened garden with protected speech, apportioned sustenance, and a morning-evening cadence, turning a destination into a maintained habitat.

activation_trace.role: The enclosed garden provides the spatial vessel that the next ayah furnishes.
The unseen leaves the habitat unspecified until the contextual details activate it.
Safety from harm gives the garden's audible social field its governing quality.
Apportioned giving makes the promised place continuously provisioned rather than merely possessed.
The beginning of day supplies one pole of a recurring provision rhythm.
Evening supplies the other pole, extending maintenance across the lived day.

structural_cues: The negated-hearing and exception construction in 19:62 removes empty speech and leaves peace as what is heard.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies safety, allotted provision, and two temporal poles; I infer that these describe the operating order of the promised garden. The two times may alternatively signify unbroken availability rather than literal diurnal cycles.

changed_reading.after: Gardens name an inhabited order whose speech, supply, and recurrence are actively maintained.

context_deltas.mechanism: The repeated garden is subsequently conveyed as inheritance to the guarded among the servants, giving the focus promise the force of advance designation for a conferred estate.

activation_trace.role: The focus promise establishes the prior commitment that inheritance later realizes.
Servanthood anchors the recipient class shared by promise and inheritance.
The repeated enclosed garden identifies the property being conveyed.
Gratuitous conveyance supplies the transfer mechanism by which the prior promise becomes possession.
Self-placement under protection marks the servant disposition associated with receiving the inheritance.

structural_cues: 19:63 demonstratively resumes 'that garden' and narrows 'our servants' with the relative condition 'whoever was guarding'.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the same garden, servant class, conveyance, and guarding; I infer that inheritance specifies the promise's mode of conferral. Alternatively, inheritance may emphasize gracious succession without implying a legal title structure.

changed_reading.before: Mercy promises servants access to a reward.
changed_reading.after: Mercy prospectively assigns an estate that will be conferred as inheritance upon servants characterized by guarding.

context_deltas.mechanism: The denial of the Lord's neglect removes forgetting as an explanation for why a promised object remains unseen, so delay no longer weakens the arrival claim.

activation_trace.role: Present hiddenness creates the interval in which delay could be mistaken for abandonment.
Commitment supplies what must persist through the unseen interval.
Expected arrival is the claim protected from an inference of lapse.
Negated leaving and neglect block abandonment as the cause of deferred fulfillment.

structural_cues: 19:64 ties descent to the Lord's command, spans what is before and behind, and ends by denying forgetfulness.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet explicitly negates the Lord's forgetting; I apply that denial backward to the nearby unseen promise. A live alternative is that the denial addresses only the timing of angelic descent.

changed_reading.before: The promise is certain despite not yet being visible.
changed_reading.after: Its invisibility is a governed delay, not an unattended gap: nonappearance supplies no evidence of neglect.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later sequence turns coming into an adjudicative route: universal arrival is made binding and executed, then rescue separates the guarded, so delivery to the promised garden may include passage through an appointed exposure.

activation_trace.role: Coming anchors the focus promise in movement toward realization.
An appointed time-place allows the promise to be read as a scheduled route rather than a free-floating assurance.
Arrival at a thing supplies the shared movement imposed on all addressees.
Binding judgment removes contingency from that arrival.
Executed action gives the binding route operative completion.
Rescue by separation supplies the exit that differentiates the garden's recipients.
Those who placed themselves under protection are the group carried through the separating rescue.

structural_cues: 19:66-72 moves from objection about renewed life through gathering and presentation to universal arrival, then contrasts rescue with being left in place.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an obligatory arrival followed by selective rescue; I infer that this route can specify how the focus promise reaches its servants. The live alternative is that the route belongs only to the threatening sequence and should not be folded into the garden's delivery.

changed_reading.before: The promised garden simply comes into reach.
changed_reading.after: Its realization may be the favorable outcome of a decreed passage and separation, with rescue functioning as delivery.

context_deltas.mechanism: The same promise root later participates in a threat of punishment, showing that the focus promise's beneficent polarity comes from Mercy, servants, and gardens together rather than from وَعَدَ alone.

activation_trace.role: The garden fixes the focus commitment on a beneficent destination.
Merciful beneficence supplies the promisor's positive agency.
The focus uses the general commitment branch to open hopeful expectation.
The threat branch activates the same root's capacity to announce harmful realization.
Painful punishment supplies the negative object that disambiguates the later promise as threat.

structural_cues: 19:75 coordinates what the opponents are promised with punishment or the Hour, then exposes who is worse in place and weaker in force.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the repeated promise root beside explicit punishment; I infer a polarity contrast with 19:61. Since the later surface is not the specialized noun 'threat', the broader alternative is that B001 already covers commitments to either good or harm.

changed_reading.after: Promise denotes reliable realization; its benevolence here is compositionally secured by the Merciful promisor, servant recipients, and garden object.

context_deltas.mechanism: Enduring repaired deeds, recompense returning to its worker, and a better return recast the garden promise as the durable outcome of a responsive moral economy rather than a detached external prize.

activation_trace.role: Promissory commitment anchors the later reward-and-return mechanism to the focus.
Arrival allows the promised result to be heard as an outcome coming back into presence.
Durability marks the kind of action whose value survives immediate circumstance.
Repair opposed to corruption characterizes the enduring deeds linked to the promised outcome.
Recompense returning to its worker supplies a responsive rather than arbitrary reward relation.
Return to a place or condition gives the outcome a terminal direction.

structural_cues: 19:76 compares enduring repaired deeds as better both in recompense and in return before the Lord.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies durability, repaired action, recompense, and return; I infer that these describe a moral feedback mechanism behind the focus promise. Alternatively, 19:76 may compare values without explaining how the garden is conferred.

changed_reading.before: The garden is an external gift that eventually arrives.
changed_reading.after: The garden can also be heard as the durable return of a relation between repaired action and divinely guaranteed recompense.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it links non-dominant bodily and botanical branches rather than the ordinary lexical senses. It remains anchored in the focus's Mercy, garden, unseen condition, and coming; downstream prose should present it only as a material analogy of protected maturation, not as a replacement translation.

activation_trace.role: The womb as a protected place of growth supplies the enclosing material analogy.
The fetus hidden within the body contributes a model of real life concealed during formation.
Tree roots hidden underground and later exposed connect invisibility to organic persistence rather than nonexistence.
Emerging growth and yield supply the eventual outward manifestation of what matured unseen.

changed_reading.before: The promised object exists elsewhere but cannot yet be seen.
changed_reading.after: As an exploratory material model, the promise is hidden because it is protected in maturation: its coming resembles emergence and yield, not mere transport from afar.

strongest_changes: The unseen garden becomes a crossed threshold and then a maintained social and provisioning order.
Inheritance gives the promise a concrete mode of gracious conferral.
Negated neglect makes delay governed rather than evidentially doubtful.
The later threatening use of the promise root shows that benevolent polarity is supplied by the focus's full composition.
summary.what_was_special: The focus compresses concealment, relational commitment, appointment, and arrival into one sentence; nearby context repeatedly unfolds those compressed terms as entry, habitation, inheritance, governed delay, adjudicative passage, and polarity contrast.
remaining_uncertainties: Whether 'in the unseen' primarily qualifies the promised garden, the servants' reception of the promise, or both.
Whether مَأْتِيًّا pictures the promise as coming, guarantees that its object will be reached, or exploits both directions.
Whether the decreed passage in 19:71-72 specifies the garden promise's realization or remains a distinct threatening sequence.
Whether morning and evening indicate literal recurrence or idiomatic continuity.
